component.name: Luanti (portal)
component.summary: Luanti fork with real-time see-through portals

description.p: Fork of Luanti 5.16 with a portal gun: real-time rendered portals (render-to-texture with oblique clip planes), seamless teleport with velocity/orientation transform, and Portal-style puzzle blocks. Bundles VoxeLibre and the yaportal mod.
